# Data Pipelines: Batch vs Streaming

Choosing between batch and streaming is one of the first decisions in any data project. Here's a framework.

## Batch

Process data at scheduled intervals. Simple, reliable, well-tooled. Choose batch when freshness requirements are in hours or days.

## Streaming

Process events as they arrive. Lower latency, higher operational complexity. Choose streaming when freshness requirements are in seconds or minutes.

## The false dichotomy

Most real systems need both: streaming for low-latency views, batch for historical backfill and reconciliation. Design your pipeline to support both from the start.
